tools.description: The app Live board (GET live/board): upcoming and in-play games, each with mainLines: its DraftKings game lines (slot, line, odds), optional league or sport, limit 1-20 and cursor. sport reads a sport chip's board across its leagues (SPRT_tennis, SPRT_soccer, SPRT_golf; tennis and golf games have no league). A league outside the app's chips is built on its first read, so that first answer can be 503 provider_unavailable with retryAfterSeconds: read again in about 60 s. Only leagues in season with a DraftKings price right now are listed: a league or sport without one answers no games (it is not in get_league_order either) and comes back by itself once its games are priced. mode: live with includeStatus: true lists only the games in play now, each with its status (a game in a league with no scoreboard feed, such as tennis or UFC, is listed while DraftKings prices it in play: its status is in_progress with the score, period and clock a public scoreboard has for it, or none; tennis: score = sets won, period = the set in play, displayClock = that set's games home-away; UFC: period = round); with includeStatus: true, eventSeries gives each game its playoff series line (round, game, summary; MLB now) or null; stale: true means some games could not be confirmed yet, so read again shortly. Use category: event_catalog for original event market identities, event_prices for an exact source-bound group at one book, or board_snapshot for one prewarmed page; those require request. pickem is the app's Pick'Em board for one game: request {eventId} returns the catalogue page and pickem.markets (full-game player Over/Under); request {eventId, marketId} returns that market's lines with DraftKings' price on each (pickem.prices). Never a wager.

Show the quote and get the customer’s yes, then start with {version: "bsd-agent-doctor-v1", action: "start", commandKey: a new key, quoteId: the quote id}. annotations.title: Let the Doctor fix a graded slip

tools.description: The app’s Fix it on an owned saved Grade jobId whose get_grade_report says fixable.offered: the Doctor reprices, swaps or drops weak legs at the slip’s own sportsbook and returns the app’s estimate (state fixed | best_reachable | no_moves, steps per leg, blockers, fixedTicket saved unplaced). after is the Doctor’s estimate, never a saved Grade: re-grade with regradeQuote to confirm. A Grade with no fix answers fix_not_offered with its reason. Paid plans, under the daily fix cap; costs no Grade. Keep commandKey (16-120 characters) stable; a replay returns the same estimate. To start the quoted re-grade after the customer confirms, call with action confirm_regrade, original jobId, fixId, confirmed true and a new commandKey; this spends a Grade. Never places a wager or moves money.
